projects.institutes: Namibia Institute of Public Health; Ministry of Health and Social Services; WHO CC GOARN; IANPHI
projects.title: TwiNit 3.0 – Namibia–RKI twinning
projects.summary: Third phase of the twinning with the newly established Namibia Institute of Public Health, focused on emergency preparedness and response, IHR, surveillance and community-based surveillance.

projects.institutes: CHU Bouaké; Université Alassane Ouattara; Helmholtz Institute for One Health
projects.title: PAcCI – Public Health Actions for Côte d'Ivoire
projects.summary: Capacity building in infectious disease surveillance and prevention: digital tools, infection control, laboratory diagnostics, One Health and outbreak management.
projects.note: Project page lists an end date of 31 Dec 2025.

projects.institutes: Laboratoire d'Analyses Médicales Malagasy (LA2M); Ministry of Health
projects.title: STRAIN – diagnostics of highly infectious bacteria
projects.summary: Strengthening laboratory diagnostics for Yersinia pestis (plague) and Vibrio cholerae in Madagascar.

projects.institutes: INSP Guinea; National Public Health Agency Sierra Leone; Africa CDC; CEA-PCMT; COMAHS
projects.title: PREPARE – effectiveness of public health and social measures
projects.summary: Multi-country pilot in Africa to develop protocols that measure how well public health and social measures work during health emergencies.

projects.institutes: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC)
projects.title: NiCaDe III – capacity development with NCDC
projects.summary: Third phase of building the Nigeria CDC's capacity for sustainable infectious disease preparedness and response.

projects.title: COPE II – community-based One Health strategy
projects.summary: Phase II (assessment phase) of a community-based, participatory One Health strategy in Nigeria.

projects.title: STEP – immunisation policy capacity
projects.summary: Building technical capacity for evidence-based decisions on immunisation policies in 16 countries of the WHO European Region.

projects.institutes: Ghana Health Service; University of Ghana; WHO Country Office
projects.title: Global Health Preparedness Programme in Ghana
projects.summary: IHR assessment (Joint External Evaluation 2016), simulation exercises, national action plan for health security, event-based surveillance, chemical-event preparedness and an environmental-health module for field epidemiology training.
projects.note: Page describes the collaboration as continuing; no end date given.

projects.institutes: WHO; IANPHI; Africa CDC; ECDC; US CDC
projects.title: NIPH global health security partner countries
projects.summary: NIPH lists Malawi, Moldova and Palestine (besides Ghana) as partner countries for IHR capacity, national public health institute strengthening and emergency preparedness.
projects.note: Dates per country not stated on the page.

projects.institutes: Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI)
projects.title: Peer-to-peer exchange NIPH – EPHI
projects.summary: An NIPH delegation met staff and leadership of the Ethiopian Public Health Institute in a peer-to-peer collaboration.
projects.note: EPHI reported in Aug 2024 that the collaboration runs under NIPH's BIS programme since 2021; BIS phase 1 ended June 2025 and a second phase depended on donor approval.

projects.institutes: National public health institutes and ministries of health; Africa CDC (regional)
projects.title: IHR Strengthening Project
projects.summary: DHSC-funded programme, implemented by UKHSA, to help partner countries prevent, detect and respond to health threats and meet IHR (2005) requirements. Also works regionally via Africa CDC, in the Eastern Mediterranean and in South-East Asia.
projects.note: Classified as 'implementation' on DevTracker; start/end dates not shown.

projects.institutes: Ethiopian Public Health Institute; NCDC Nigeria; INS Mozambique; Zambia NPHI; others
projects.title: CDC support to national public health institute development
projects.summary: CDC's overview of countries where it helps establish or strengthen national public health institutes (strategic planning, surveillance, laboratory systems, workforce, emergency response).
projects.note: Undated overview page; individual country engagements may have ended.

projects.institutes: IANPHI; WHO/Europe (Ukraine)
projects.title: CDC–IANPHI partnership for NPHIs
projects.summary: Since 2011: planning support for Zambia's NPHI (2015), consultation for Burkina Faso's institute (2018), an assessment of Ukraine's Public Health Center (2019) and Staged Development Tool workshops in several countries.

projects.institutes: IANPHI; US CDC
projects.title: African NPHI peer learning around Mozambique's INS
projects.summary: Delegations from Malawi and Zambia (2016) and Sierra Leone and Uganda (2017) visited Mozambique's national institute to learn from its set-up.

projects.institutes: Kenya Ministry of Health (DPPHS); IANPHI
projects.title: Kenya–Canada peer-to-peer partnership
projects.summary: PHAC hosted a study tour for Kenya's new Directorate of Preventive and Promotive Health Services on how a national public health agency is set up.

projects.institutes: French Government (signed by France's ambassador to Ethiopia)
projects.title: Africa CDC – France MoU
projects.summary: MoU of 14 Sep 2023 covering support for Africa CDC and new national public health institutes, surveillance, local production of vaccines and diagnostics, workforce training and research partnerships.
projects.note: Partner is the French state, not a public health institute.

projects.institutes: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC, Stockholm)
projects.title: Africa CDC – ECDC MoU
projects.summary: MoU (reported March 2026) on surveillance, risk assessment, emergency preparedness, AMR, vaccine-preventable diseases, modelling, laboratories and training. A new five-year Team Europe initiative was reported to start in May 2026 after the previous partnership ended in April 2026.

projects.institutes: Africa CDC
projects.title: China CDC – Africa CDC cooperation
projects.summary: Reciprocal visits in Nov and Dec 2024 on disease prevention and control, surveillance and the mpox response.
projects.note: No formal agreement mentioned in the source.

projects.institutes: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)
projects.title: RIVM – ICMR letter of intent
projects.summary: Five-year letter of intent (following an MoU of June 2025) on climate change and health, infectious diseases including AMR, vector-borne diseases, One Health and surveillance, with joint projects and capacity building.
projects.note: Signature dates on the document are ambiguous (2026).

projects.institutes: African Union Scientific, Technical and Research Commission
projects.title: ICMR – African Union MoU
projects.summary: MoU of 2019 on South–South health research collaboration, capacity building and development of drugs, diagnostics and vaccines for regional priority diseases.
projects.note: Partner is the African Union (seat Addis Ababa), not an NPHI.

projects.actor: Univ. of Copenhagen / DTU / Univ. of Gothenburg
projects.institutes: National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR); SUZA; UDSM; KCRI; NMCP; ZAMEP
projects.title: Pre-VBD – climate-based early warning for malaria and dengue
projects.summary: Early warning system forecasting malaria, dengue and chikungunya risk as climate changes, being integrated into Tanzania's DHIS2. Universities rather than an NPHI lead from the European side; included as the closest climate-and-health match found for Tanzania. The Robert Koch Institute is not named.

projects.institutes: RIVM (National Institute for Public Health and the Environment)
projects.title: China CDC – RIVM memorandum of understanding
projects.summary: Agreement signed during an RIVM delegation visit to Beijing covering ten areas, among them infectious and chronic disease control, health promotion and cross-border outbreak response; the visit included a One Health seminar.

projects.institutes: Robert Koch Institute
projects.title: China CDC – Robert Koch Institute memorandum of understanding
projects.summary: Five-year cooperation agreement between the two national institutes on infectious diseases, health emergencies, non-communicable diseases, laboratory safety and workforce training.
projects.note: Signed by video link on 23 July 2024 for five years; end year derived from that term.

projects.institutes: Instituto de Medicina Tropical Pedro Kourí (IPK)
projects.title: China CDC – IPK Cuba memorandum of understanding
projects.summary: Agreement between China CDC and Cuba's tropical medicine institute, both IANPHI members, on tropical disease control, laboratory diagnostics, emergency response and training.
projects.note: Exact signing date not stated; page updated 26 Aug 2026.

projects.institutes: Instituto Nacional de Salud (INS) Colombia
projects.title: China CDC – INS Colombia technical exchange
projects.summary: First bilateral video meeting between the two institutes, framed as the start of cooperation on surveillance, emergency preparedness and laboratory capacity. No formal agreement is mentioned.

projects.institutes: Africa CDC; national public health institutes of the four countries
projects.title: SPhIRhA – Strengthening Public Health Institutes for Resilience in Health in Africa
projects.summary: Sida-funded four-year project, coordinated by the Swedish agency together with Africa CDC, to strengthen four African NPHIs with a particular focus on sexual and reproductive health and rights.
projects.note: Announced April 2025 as a four-year project; exact start and end not given.

projects.institutes: Nine national public health institutes (incl. NPHIL Liberia)
projects.title: Africa CDC NPHI centres of excellence
projects.summary: Africa CDC funded nine national public health institutes to act as regional hubs offering technical assistance, training and mentoring to peers, with plans to twin them with European NPHIs through ECDC.

projects.institutes: CAS-TWAS Centre of Excellence for Emerging Infectious Diseases (CEEID)
projects.title: Fiocruz – CEEID Sino-Brazilian infectious disease centre
projects.summary: Scientific cooperation agreement to set up a joint research and prevention centre for infectious diseases with sites in Beijing and Rio de Janeiro, covering arboviruses, influenza, TB, vaccines and diagnostics.
projects.note: Signed in Beijing, April 2023; no term stated.
